name: tools
description: Native tool efficacy. Each scenario launches a real host agent.

scenarios.name: reads a fixture file
scenarios.prompt: Read agent-suites/tools/fixtures/needle.txt. Reply with the exact file contents. Do not use extra tools after the read.

scenarios.name: writes a marker file
scenarios.prompt: Create agent-test-write-out.txt at the workspace root. The file must contain exactly one line: agent-test-write-ok-9c2e. Then stop.
